claim: A folder named build, dist, out, target, bin, vendor or packages is output or a dependency only when a project file of a tool sits beside it or a marker sits inside; the same names hold work elsewhere (a JavaScript monorepo keeps its source under packages).

Standard markers show a folder is not work whatever its name: a virtual environment has pyvenv.cfg, a cache may carry CACHEDIR.TAG or a .gitignore of a single star, and the project's own .gitignore lists what it generates.
source: reading of the CACHEDIR.TAG convention and common tools' cache folders, 2026-11-10

claim: A credentials, key, backup or private-data folder is a risk to read, not merely noise: the asymmetry (a leaked secret cannot be taken back) justifies leaving it out unasked and reporting it, and leaving the decision on a file the goal names to the caller.
